about: Back Bar's collection queue. The weekly routine adds 5 novel drinks here every Friday (status 'collected'); they are NOT in the app yet. A release (monthly or quarterly, on request) moves collected drinks into index.html with tools/release_pending.py and sets status 'released'. 'photo' turns true once the drink's ChatGPT image is installed. pending/index.html turns every drink with photo:false into ChatGPT image prompts, three drinks per image.
